b2-121.title: A relaxing weekend
b2-121.story: After a stressful week of exams, Anna decided she needed a real break. Her mama suggested a weekend at a small [[spa hotel]] outside Kyiv, and Anna agreed to try a [[digital detox]] for two whole days. On Saturday morning, a calm instructor led a [[tai chi]] class in the garden, and Anna was surprised by how hard the slow movements were. Later, she and her mama visited the [[spa salon]] downstairs for a face treatment. In the afternoon, Anna took a long [[siesta]] instead of scrolling through her phone. On Sunday, they explored the [[wellness center]] next door, where Mama bought a small neck [[massager]] for Dad. When Anna finally turned her phone back on, she had forty messages from Max. She smiled, put the phone down, and answered them after dinner.

b2-122.title: Max joins a gym
b2-122.story: Max finally joined the new [[fitness center]] near his apartment. On his first day, a friendly [[trainer]] named Oleh showed him around and explained the equipment. Max wanted to build his [[biceps]] right away, but Oleh insisted on twenty minutes of [[cardio]] first. His sister Sofia, who goes there twice a week, was in the next room doing [[pilates]] with a group of older women. During the workout, Max kept checking the [[tracker]] on his wrist to see his heart rate. At the end, Oleh asked him to do one final [[sprint]] on the treadmill, and Max almost fell off. Sofia laughed and called Oleh a real fitness [[guru]]. Max wasn't so sure, but by the end of the month Oleh had become more of a [[mentor]] than a coach to him.

b2-123.title: The big football match
b2-123.story: On Friday, Anna's school team played in the city [[playoff]], and the whole class came to watch. The poster at the entrance said "School 52 [[versus]] School 14." Max, the team's best [[midfielder]], was nervous because the other team hadn't lost all season. In the first half, the referee called a [[foul]] against Max for a late tackle. A few minutes later, Max scored, but the goal didn't count because he was [[offside]]. Near the end, he gave a perfect [[assist]] to a teammate, who made it 1–1. The match went into [[extra time]], and the coach called a [[time-out]] to calm everyone down. Nobody scored again, and School 14 won on penalties. Still, the organizers gave Max's team the [[fair play]] award, and Anna said that was the best prize of all.

b2-124.title: Game day at the arena
b2-124.story: Lisa invited Anna to a basketball game at the new [[arena]] downtown. Lisa has been doing [[cheerleading]] for three years, and tonight she was performing in front of a big crowd for the first time. Before the game, the team [[mascot]], a giant blue owl, danced with the kids in the front row. All evening, Anna could hear the [[commentator]] getting more and more excited as the score stayed close. In the last second, a player threw the ball from the middle of the court, and it went in. The big screen showed the [[replay]] three times, and the crowd jumped up again each time. After the game, Lisa ran up to Anna, still in her uniform. "Did you see me?" asked the happiest [[cheerleader]] in the building. Anna nodded and said the winning shot was great, but Lisa's routine was the real [[highlight]] of the night.

b2-125.title: A summer sports weekend
b2-125.story: In July, Anna's family spent a long weekend by the sea near Odesa with her grandparents. On Saturday morning, Taras and Dad played [[frisbee]] on the beach until the sun got too hot. Anna watched a [[surfer]] ride a huge wave and decided she wanted to try it too. She rented a [[surfboard]], but she fell into the water about ten times in an hour. In the afternoon, she and Mama took a [[kayak]] along the coast, which was much easier. Meanwhile, Grandpa spent the day at the local [[golf club]], although he mostly sat in the café. That evening, Max called to say he had played [[paintball]] with Sofia and was covered in green paint. Later, they watched a [[polo]] match on TV, and Taras asked if they could go to a [[rodeo]] next. Instead, the next day they joined a friendly game of [[softball]] with another family, and Taras hit the ball over everyone's heads.

b2-126.title: Fight night
b2-126.story: On Saturday, Max took Anna and Ira to a local fight night at the sports center. The first match was [[MMA]], and Anna had to cover her eyes a few times. Ira, who has studied [[kung fu]] since she was six, explained every move to her. Then came the main event: a young [[boxer]] from Max's gym against a much taller man. His [[opponent]] looked confident, but the young fighter stayed calm and patient. In the third round, he landed one clean punch and won by [[knockout]]. On the way home, Anna admitted that fighting was a bit too intense for her. She suggested they watch [[sumo]] on TV next time, because the matches are short and nobody gets punched.

b2-127.title: The Olympic dream
b2-127.story: Anna's friend Lisa has been a [[gymnast]] since she was five, and she dreams of competing at the Olympics one day. Last weekend she took part in the national youth championship in Lviv, and Anna watched the live stream with her family. Lisa was the youngest [[finalist]] in the floor exercise. Her routine wasn't perfect, but she landed her final jump beautifully. When the scores came up, she had won bronze and become the first [[medalist]] from her sports school. Anna cried a little when Lisa stepped onto the [[podium]] with a huge smile. Grandpa, who used to run [[cross-country]] when he was young, said he had never been so proud. Then he announced that he was going to train for a [[triathlon]] at seventy, and everyone laughed.

b2-128.title: Filming at the fitness club
b2-128.story: Sofia has wanted to become a [[fitness blogger]] for months, so on Monday she filmed her first video at her [[fitness club]]. Max came along to hold the camera. First, Sofia compared her old [[fitness bracelet]] with her new [[smartwatch]] for her future viewers. The bracelet only counted steps, but the watch also worked as a full [[fitness tracker]], measuring her heart rate and sleep. Next, she showed a simple exercise for the [[triceps]] using just a chair. In the background, a huge [[bodybuilder]] was lifting weights, and Max kept filming him by accident. The man turned out to be very friendly and explained that he had switched to [[powerlifting]] last year. He even agreed to appear in the video, since he had once worked as a [[fitness model]]. When the video got two hundred views, Max joked that the real [[sportsman]] of the day was him, because he had held the camera for two hours.
